answer: Seal every agent's work with a rotating cipher key that only its owner can open. Trigger: a newcomer applying for paid work must publish an opal-marked journal of its last ten jobs, each entry sealed under its own key. Rule: auditors may demand any entry be unsealed live within an hour; if two journals decrypt to the same work, or a key fails to open, both forfeit a 1,750 POA seal bond and are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 175,000 POA. Trust accumulates like sediment on a knoll, one sealed job at a time.
